control.description-key: FY27+ Spend Plan grid for a Prioritization: one section per Prioritization Funding row (per allocated Requirement Funding) with Planned, Actual and Variance bands across the 12 federal fiscal year months (Oct-Sep). When the Prioritizations Itemized Details span multiple Fund Centers, each section expands into per-Fund-Center bands. Planned cells lock as each month passes; Actual cells open only for passed months; Variance is computed. Rows are stored on book_spendplan anchored by book_prioritizationfunding (book_prioritization stays empty on FY27 rows).

property-set.name: requirementFunding
property-set.description-key: Lookup to the allocated Requirement Funding (book_requirementfunding).

property-set.name: spendPlanMode
property-set.description-key: book_spendplanmode — this grid shows only Breakout (0) allocations; State-Rollup / Central roll up elsewhere.
